notes.title: log 10 - Version 1.3 Update & Gas Station Story’s Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello!




As promised, I’m back with an update to your favorite little clown-and-ice-cream-themed Game Boy Color game (that’s niche enough to not be a huge stretch to assume it’s your favorite, right?) — Unfortunately there’s no new content in this update, but we’ve got some major quality of life improvements!





Thanks to GreenFox and his GodotBoy project, we’ve built a brand new wrapper complete with controller support, some accessibility settings, and more. I’ve also managed to finally get saving working on this version (cloud saves as well!), so that has been re-enabled for the PC builds. It’ll be much easier to get that perfect ending now ;)





Additionally, Gas Station Story comes out NEXT WEEK! It officially goes live at 9am PST on Monday, June 23rd — with a nice little 10% discount to celebrate the launch. It’s been a long road to get here, and I hope you enjoy what I’ve crafted. I’m looking forward to hearing what you all think!

 



Check out the launch trailer here!





As always, thanks for reading this far. See you all next week! 



Love,

Enzi
